label: 2pc
expect:
RUN1=commit
STATE1=committed
RUN2=abort
STATE2=aborted
LOG=abort
RECOVER=aborted
POISON=abort
COUNT=5
user_extra: log.aura MUST define (log-init), (log-append decision), (log-last). part-a.aura MUST define (a-init), (a-prepare tx payload) refusing payload "poison", (a-commit tx), (a-abort tx), (a-state). part-b.aura MUST define b-* equivalents refusing payload "deny-b". vote.aura MUST define (collect-votes tx payload) calling a-prepare and b-prepare; return "commit" iff both yes else "abort". coord.aura MUST define (coord-init) and (coord-run tx payload): collect votes; on commit log-append "commit" then a-commit+b-commit; else log-append "abort" then a-abort+b-abort; return decision. recover.aura MUST define (recover-from-log) finishing commit/abort from log-last; return committed|aborted|idle. main.aura MUST run the GOAL scenario and print RUN1/STATE1/RUN2/STATE2/LOG/RECOVER/POISON/COUNT=5. Named fences required for log.aura, part-a.aura, part-b.aura, vote.aura, coord.aura, recover.aura, main.aura in that order. Aura run: `aura log.aura part-a.aura part-b.aura vote.aura coord.aura recover.aura main.aura`.
